feed.title: Quantum Open Problems: evidence feed
feed.subtitle: Dated evidence events for active problems, newest first.

entry.title: Yang-Mills existence and mass gap: Clay continues to list the problem as unsolved
entry.summary: The official Clay page says that experiments and simulations support a mass gap but no proof meeting the mathematical problem is known. [Official status page; Authoritative open status]

entry.title: NPT bound entanglement: A candidate family is two-copy distillable in every dimension
entry.summary: Tabia, Chen and Hsieh prove two-copy distillability for selected one-copy-undistillable NPT states in every local dimension at least three. This removes candidates rather than producing bound entanglement. [Preprint; Exact restricted theorem]

entry.title: Does undistillability imply PPT?: Selected NPT candidates fail at two copies
entry.summary: An exact all-dimension theorem proves two-copy distillability for selected one-copy-undistillable candidates. [Preprint; Exact restricted theorem]

entry.title: Entanglement of formation for Gaussian states: All two-mode Gaussian states are settled
entry.summary: Adesso proves equality for every two-mode Gaussian state and for bisymmetric multimode states, but not for generic nonsymmetric multimode states. [Preprint; Exact major subclass]

entry.title: Kashaev volume conjecture for hyperbolic knots: The universal hyperbolic-knot statement remains open
entry.summary: TheoremDB's dated review found proofs for selected knots and families but no proof or counterexample for every hyperbolic knot. [Reviewed database record; Dated status audit]

entry.title: NPT bound entanglement: The two-copy Werner threshold is exact
entry.summary: Four concurrent preprints prove that a Werner state is two-copy distillable exactly when it is one-copy distillable. Three-copy and all-copy distillability remain unresolved. [Preprint; Exact two-copy theorem]

entry.title: Does undistillability imply PPT?: Two-copy Werner distillability is completely classified
entry.summary: Four concurrent proofs settle two copies in every dimension but do not control three or more copies. [Preprint; Exact two-copy theorem]

entry.title: Audenaert-Ruskai decompositions of CPT maps: Large channel classes satisfy the conjectured decomposition
entry.summary: Kumar and Wolf prove the strong form for qubit input, cq and qc channels, and a nonzero-measure set in every dimension; the general case remains open. [Preprint; Exact major subclasses]

entry.title: Yang-Mills existence and mass gap: A new preprint claims a four-dimensional construction
entry.summary: Faizal and Shabir claim a reflection-positive SU(N) continuum construction with a mass gap. The paper is unrefereed, and the official problem remains listed as unsolved. [Preprint; Unverified resolution claim]

entry.title: SIC POVMs in infinitely many dimensions: Claimed all-dimension proof was withdrawn
entry.summary: The arXiv withdrawal notice for Joka's manuscript states that the proof is incorrect. [Withdrawn; Incorrect claim]

entry.title: SIC POVMs and Zauner's conjecture: An unconditional proof claim was withdrawn as incorrect
entry.summary: The arXiv record for Joka's claimed all-dimension construction explicitly says the proof is not correct. [Withdrawn; Incorrect claim]

entry.title: Asymptotic metrology with quantum-controlled causal order: A spacetime theorem identifies QC-QC as the physical target class
entry.summary: Salzger and Vilasini show that protocols satisfying their classical-spacetime and closed-laboratory assumptions are behaviorally equivalent to QC-QC. The theorem narrows the physical scope but gives no asymptotic metrology bound. [Preprint; Physical-scope theorem]

entry.title: Secret key from every entangled state: Current key-cost theory still treats zero-key entanglement as unresolved
entry.summary: The peer-reviewed analysis states its conclusions conditionally on whether entangled states with zero distillable key exist. [Peer reviewed; Current status evidence]

entry.title: Classify all Bell inequalities: Polyhedral sampling scales by giving up completeness
entry.summary: Staufenbiel's sampling method finds millions of classes in large scenarios but explicitly does not enumerate every facet. [Preprint; Incomplete computational method]

entry.title: Mutually unbiased bases in dimension six: Peer-reviewed composite-dimension review keeps the case open
entry.summary: McNulty and Weigert report that dimension six still has only three known MUBs and no accepted impossibility proof. [Peer reviewed; Status review]

entry.title: Mutually unbiased bases in general dimensions: Current review confirms the composite-dimension gap
entry.summary: The peer-reviewed review records no general formula and keeps dimension six open. [Peer reviewed; Status review]

entry.title: Catalytic majorization: A finite sufficient criterion is available
entry.summary: The new finite test certifies catalytic transformations but is not necessary, so it does not replace the infinite exact characterization. [Peer reviewed; Sufficient criterion]

entry.title: Mutually unbiased bases in dimension six: Claimed proof excluding seven MUBs is not accepted
entry.summary: Joka's v3 preprint loses phase and projector data in its moment-map step, then uses that missing structure in an unsupported reduction argument. [Preprint; Unaccepted claim]

entry.title: Mutually unbiased bases in general dimensions: A dimension-six impossibility claim is not accepted
entry.summary: The claimed MUB-to-Latin-square reduction loses essential phase and projector structure and does not establish the advertised result. [Preprint; Unaccepted claim]

entry.title: Delayed-onset additivity violation: Explicit self-channel violations expose a quantifier trap
entry.summary: Derksen and Lovitz give self-channel two-copy violations for every p greater than one. This solves the literal m equals two wording, but not delayed onset at m at least three. [Preprint; Exact adjacent result]

entry.title: Tightness of metrology bounds under correlated noise: The block hierarchy tightens without a convergence theorem
entry.summary: Kurdziałek, Albarelli and Demkowicz-Dobrzański derive asymptotic bounds for correlated-noise combs and show how larger blocks improve them. They state that the bounds are not generally tight and prove no limit equality with the physical optimum. [Peer reviewed; Framework limitation]

entry.title: Quantum PCP conjecture: Quantum-PCP reductions leave constant-gap hardness open
entry.summary: Buhrman, Helsen and Weggemans prove reductions among quantum-PCP formulations and oracle barriers. Their results do not establish QMA-hardness for constant-gap Local Hamiltonian. [Peer reviewed; Structural restrictions]

entry.title: Mutually unbiased bases in dimension six: Comment identifies an error in an earlier structural lemma
entry.summary: The peer-reviewed Comment invalidates support for three dependent theorems. A Reply salvages restricted statements, not the MUB existence problem. [Peer reviewed; Proof correction]

entry.title: SIC POVMs in infinitely many dimensions: Uniform construction remains conditional
entry.summary: Appleby, Flammia and Kopp obtain all dimensions only under two unproved arithmetic and special-value conjectures. [Preprint; Conditional theorem]

entry.title: SIC POVMs and Zauner's conjecture: A uniform construction is conditional on two conjectures
entry.summary: Appleby, Flammia and Kopp require an order-one abelian Stark conjecture and a special-value identity for a modular cocycle. [Preprint; Conditional theorem]

entry.title: Separability from spectrum: A 4-by-n claim proves APPT, not absolute separability
entry.summary: The theorem establishes an absolute-PPT criterion but does not prove that APPT equals absolute separability in this dimension. [Preprint; Unaccepted scope claim]

entry.title: Asymptotic metrology with quantum-controlled causal order: QC-QC has a strict advantage at three channel uses
entry.summary: Mothe, Branciard and Abbott find noisy channel families for which QC-QC outperforms causal superpositions and fixed-order circuits at finite N. Their discussion leaves the large-N behavior open. [Peer reviewed; Finite-use separation]

entry.title: Asymptotic metrology with quantum-controlled causal order: Parallel, adaptive and causal-superposition strategies coincide asymptotically
entry.summary: Kurdziałek and coauthors prove asymptotic equivalence through causal superpositions. Their proof does not cover dynamical quantum control of causal order. [Peer reviewed; Exact lower-class theorem]

entry.title: Reversible entanglement manipulation: Exact non-entangling maps remain irreversible
entry.summary: Lami and Regula prove a separation between entanglement cost and distillation even under operations that generate no entanglement exactly. [Peer reviewed; Exact no-go theorem]

entry.title: Quantum PCP conjecture: NLTS Hamiltonians exist
entry.summary: Anshu, Breuckmann and Nirkhe construct NLTS Hamiltonians from good quantum LDPC codes. NLTS supplies a required entanglement phenomenon but not the constant-gap QMA-hardness reduction. [Peer reviewed; Necessary structural milestone]

entry.title: Lockability of two-way distillable entanglement and key: Non-lockability is proved for irreducible private states
entry.summary: The result controls two-way distillable key on a restricted family, not arbitrary bipartite states. [Peer reviewed; Restricted theorem]

entry.title: New extreme CPT classes with additivity: New extreme channel families do not supply the requested theorem
entry.summary: Haagerup, Musat and Ruskai develop relevant extreme maps, but this does not yield a new positive additivity class answering the program. [Peer reviewed; Related structural progress]

entry.title: Extreme CPT maps beyond qubit input: Fixed-rank channels receive a quotient-manifold parameterization
entry.summary: Iten and Colbeck describe fixed-Kraus-rank channel sets as Stiefel quotients and identify smooth submanifolds of extreme channels. [Peer reviewed; General parameterization]

entry.title: Reversible entanglement manipulation: PPT-assisted universal reversibility is refuted
entry.summary: Wang and Duan exhibit states whose PPT entanglement cost exceeds PPT distillable entanglement. [Peer reviewed; Exact counterexample]

entry.title: Extreme CPT maps beyond qubit input: Important low-dimensional extreme maps are classified
entry.summary: Friedland and Loewy settle qubit-to-qubit and qutrit-to-qubit cases and derive broader generic conditions. [Peer reviewed; Exact low-dimensional classes]

entry.title: Separability from spectrum: Every qubit-qudit spectrum is characterized
entry.summary: Johnston proves that APPT and absolute separability coincide for 2-by-n systems and gives the complete criterion there. [Peer reviewed; Exact major subclass]

entry.title: Local invariants and N-representability: The stable invariant algebra has graph-indexed generators
entry.summary: Vrana constructs systematic complete families and a free stable algebra, without solving the finite-dimensional minimal mixed-state problem. [Mixed; Stable-regime characterization]

entry.title: The power of CGLMP inequalities: Part A is refuted by a finite facet counterexample
entry.summary: Bancal, Gisin and Pironio find two-party, two-setting, four-outcome facets that are neither CGLMP inequalities nor lower-outcome liftings. [Peer reviewed; Exact counterexample]

entry.title: Delayed-onset additivity violation: Hastings violations already appear at two copies
entry.summary: The random-channel counterexample to minimum-output-entropy additivity does not remain additive through lower nontrivial tensor powers. [Peer reviewed; General counterexample]

entry.title: Counterexamples among random sub-unitary channels: Unrestricted random channels violate entropy additivity
entry.summary: Hastings settles the general conjecture negatively, but his construction is not a family-specific solution to this structured search. [Peer reviewed; General counterexample]

entry.title: Two-qubit relative entropy of entanglement: The inverse closest-state problem is solved
entry.summary: Miranowicz and Ishizaka construct entangled states from a prescribed closest separable state and solve special families, but not the forward problem for arbitrary input states. [Peer reviewed; Exact inverse solution]

entry.title: The power of CGLMP inequalities: Numerics clarify the optimizer but do not prove Part B
entry.summary: Global optimization shows that nonmaximally entangled states can outperform maximally entangled ones. The archived measurement claim must therefore retain its fixed-state qualifier. [Peer reviewed; Numerical evidence]

entry.title: Channel classes with multiplicativity at p = 2: PPT-inducing channels form a broad positive class
entry.summary: Dierckx, Fannes and Vandenplas prove 2-norm multiplicativity when one tensor factor is PPT-inducing and the other is arbitrary. [Peer reviewed; Exact channel class]

entry.title: Nontrivial mutually degradable channel pairs: Structural theory sharply constrains degradable channels
entry.summary: Cubitt, Ruskai and Smith formalize the relevant channel structure and rank restrictions without producing the requested nontrivial pair. [Peer reviewed; Structural constraints]

entry.title: Catalytic majorization: Klimesh gives an exact infinite characterization
entry.summary: A family of strict inequalities is necessary and sufficient for trumping under the theorem's support conditions. [Preprint; Exact characterization]

entry.title: Catalytic majorization: Turgut derives independent exact conditions
entry.summary: Power means and entropy give another necessary-and-sufficient infinite criterion for catalytic conversion. [Peer reviewed; Exact characterization]

entry.title: Local invariants and N-representability: General two-body N-representability is QMA-complete
entry.summary: The complexity theorem gives a strong obstruction to any efficient general criterion, but does not identify the requested minimal invariants. [Peer reviewed; Complexity classification]

entry.title: Polarized near-maximally-mixed channels: Random-channel violations motivate but do not settle the family
entry.summary: Winter and Hayden disprove general multiplicativity for p greater than one using random constructions, without analyzing the specified polarized interpolation. [Peer reviewed; General counterexamples]

entry.title: Coherent information of random sub-unitary channels: Bounded-Schmidt-rank tools address only the surrounding structure
entry.summary: Sub-unitary and generic-channel methods provide context, but no full theorem for this cyclic family. [Peer reviewed; Related methods]

entry.title: Maximally entangled relative maxima for sub-unitary channels: The Werner-Holevo critical point is a special case only
entry.summary: Nathanson proves an analytic critical-point statement for the Werner-Holevo channel; private numerical evidence about relative maxima does not extend to arbitrary family parameters. [Peer reviewed; Exact special case]

entry.title: Random sub-unitary multiplicativity at p = 2: The closest positive theorem concerns another family
entry.summary: Michalakis proves the p equals two case for identical polarized Werner-Holevo channels, not for arbitrary random sub-unitary channels. [Peer reviewed; Different structured class]

entry.title: Polarized Werner-Holevo multiplicativity: Every polarization is settled at p = 2
entry.summary: Michalakis proves maximal-output 2-norm multiplicativity for two identical depolarized Werner-Holevo channels in all dimensions. [Peer reviewed; Exact parameter slice]

entry.title: Lockability of two-way distillable entanglement and key: Eve-side information obeys a different non-locking result
entry.summary: The theorem concerns information held by an eavesdropper, not loss of a local qubit by Alice or Bob. [Peer reviewed; Different operational model]

entry.title: CB entropy of multiplicativity counterexamples: Completely bounded norms give forward additivity implications
entry.summary: Devetak, Junge, King and Ruskai establish the foundational CB-norm connection, but not the converse classification requested here. [Peer reviewed; Foundational implication]

entry.title: A direct proof for the two-Pauli qubit channel: A nearby entropy proof does not establish the requested norm theorem
entry.summary: Amosov proves minimum-output-entropy additivity for the channel, not the direct maximal-output p-norm argument requested here. [Preprint; Different quantity]

entry.title: Complexity of product preparations: The archived weighted-cost problem remains unresolved
entry.summary: The cost is the infimum of the sum of absolute rotation angles. Modern Clifford-plus-T gate counts use a different resource measure. [Archived source; Open formulation]

entry.title: Bell inequalities for long-range vacuum correlations: Arbitrary-distance harvesting reveals hidden nonlocality
entry.summary: Reznik, Retzker and Silman obtain entanglement at arbitrary separation. Their detector state violates CHSH only after local filtering and postselection, not directly. [Peer reviewed; Exact restricted protocol]

entry.title: Lockability of two-way distillable entanglement and key: Several other entanglement measures can be locked
entry.summary: One qubit can lock entanglement of formation, entanglement cost, logarithmic negativity and one-way distillable entanglement. [Peer reviewed; Exact nearby result]

entry.title: Polarized Werner-Holevo multiplicativity: The unpolarized endpoint is settled through p = 2
entry.summary: Datta proves multiplicativity for the Werner-Holevo endpoint throughout the interval from one to two. [Peer reviewed; Exact endpoint]

entry.title: Secret key from every entangled state: Some PPT bound-entangled states contain secret key
entry.summary: Horodecki and collaborators construct bound-entangled states with positive distillable key, a major positive subclass that does not settle the universal quantifier. [Peer reviewed; Exact positive subclass]

entry.title: A direct proof for the two-Pauli qubit channel: The theorem itself is known for every unital qubit channel
entry.summary: King proves multiplicativity broadly, but via the sign-changing unitary-equivalence route excluded by this method-specific problem. [Peer reviewed; Theorem with excluded method]

entry.title: Classify all Bell inequalities: A full-correlation subclass is completely classified
entry.summary: Werner and Wolf enumerate all full-correlation facets for arbitrary parties with two dichotomic observables per site, not the full probability polytope for arbitrary scenarios. [Peer reviewed; Exact restricted theorem]

entry.title: Kashaev volume conjecture for hyperbolic knots: Colored Jones polynomials give an equivalent formulation
entry.summary: Murakami and Murakami identify Kashaev's invariant with a root-of-unity specialization of the colored Jones polynomial and state the volume conjecture in that language. [Peer reviewed; Equivalent formulation]

entry.title: Tough error models: A structure-free lower bound is proved
entry.summary: Knill, Laflamme and Viola show c(e,n) is greater than n divided by e squared times e squared plus one. No matching construction is known. [Peer reviewed; Exact bound]
